tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The price quoted should be inclusive of all expenses towards resource persons/trainers, training materials, travel/local conveyance, AV arrangements, documentation/reporting and other training-related expenditure,and also Lunch, Tea, Water bottles etc, and all applicable taxes
Payment shall be made on satisfactory completion of the one-day training programme and submission/acceptance of the completion report and other deliverables.

Payment of the bill shall be made subject to the release of funds by the Government. In case the release of grant is delayed for any period, this office shall not be liable to pay any additional amount in any manner.

Trainers/Resource Persons: The bidder shall deploy suitably qualified and experienced trainers/resource persons having knowledge relevant to municipal solid waste management, source segregation, collection systems, occupational safety and related field practices.

Responsibilities of the Agency/Service Provider: Arrange trainers, training materials, audio-visual facilities, demonstrations and other resources required for effective conduct of the workshop, maintain attendance and provide photographs, feedback and completion documentation
The Client reserves the right to accept or reject any proposal in accordance with applicable rules.
No Consultant shall have a right to claim compensation merely because its proposal has not been accepted.
RATE TO BE MENTIONED IN THE E-PORTAL by carefully reading and understanding the Works Mentioned in the Tender Document
